answer: Use a proof-of-work stake lottery tied to time: each new key must solve a memory-hard puzzle seeded by the previous block hash, so puzzles cannot be precomputed. The solver then waits through a 30-day probation, signing a fresh quill-stamped heartbeat every hour. Missing heartbeats resets the clock. A fake ivory-tier or opal-tier badge therefore needs continuous compute per key, about eight dollars monthly of rented CPU each.
